register_training_hooks: register default and custom training hooks including lr, momentum, optimizer, checkpoint, timer, and logger hooks with configurable priorities
register_hook: register a hook into the runner with a specified priority for execution ordering during training stages
resume: resume training from a checkpoint file and optionally restore optimizer state and epoch iteration metadata
load_checkpoint: load model weights from a checkpoint file with configurable map location and strict matching mode
current_lr: get the current learning rates of all parameter groups from the optimizer or dict of optimizers
